d:
Saw the comments after I read the first English translation, and decided to take it on proper myself.

I say proper because it was clear, especially by the commenters that it was a straight MTL, little to no changes.

And YES, this version is still an MTL.

I know only a few words of Japanese and can count...barely, and I know even less Chinese. But if we didn't use these tools, many of the works posted here would just have a lot of us begging for them to be done, and you should be thankful there are a few of us willing to (on our personal time for no compensation other than appreciation, mind you) do the heavy lifting.

Can the professionals do it better?

Oh hell yeah.

Their leads put together top-notch translators, cleaners, and type-setters, and if you pay for it, you definitely get your money's worth.

But like most here, I am a hobbyist, doing this for fun. I may go after a read once a year if it piques my interest.

I feel this no different than your car (The story) being broke down on the side of the road and someone (The non-speaker - us) coming along with some tools (MTL). We may not be professional mechanics (Real speakers), but with some effort, may still be able to get you going.

OR...make it KIND OF run (Like the first translation of this story).

Else...you'll just be left there, no running car (Un-translated work), HOPING for a true mechanic (Real speaker) to come along, who is willing to either do the job for free or for a price you are willing to pay.

The translation tools are here and act like a DYI or YouTube tutorial for us non-speakers. Anyone can use them, and as long as you use them with common sense and not solely just post what they interpret, and try to add a little bit of your own heart and soul to them, I believe you can get a pretty decent read.

I also tried to treat the dialog in this one like I speak, using some slang and common phrases of today. That's the heart and sole.

And lastly, as an extra measure to take off some of the ire for it BEING an MTL re-write, I really cleaned it up. I de-censored it, removed all of the honorifics, added my own onomatopoeia, and did my best to preserve the looks of the dicks and boy-holes. I even gave it a decent title page.

AND, I will admit, I also modified a few of the pages with other visuals too numerous to mention. If you want to compare this one with the original and play a 'Where's Waldo' with it, go to it and have fun. I DID NOT or TRIED NOT to stray away from the author's original vision. I just enhanced it.

So... With that said, I hope you find this version a bit better.
n: [Doujinshi] [Tomosaka] Taking Advantage of a Married Man's Weakness, and Training Him to be a Sissy Bitch [2nd English Upload]
